messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages + launch posts + webinar hooks. Need final hero lines, 3 launch-post headlines, one short benchmark narrative for the webinar, and inbound form routing mapping. Goal: ship assets by EOD Thu.
Diego: Got it. Do we want to keep messaging super technical (latency/cost numbers) or more value-led for hero?
Maya: Hero should be value-led + 1 datapoint under the fold. e.g., hero: promise + 1-line detail w/metric. Technical specs can live in the sections below.
Priya: Suggested hero drafts: Hosted — "Start generating in minutes. Pay-as-you-go inference with streaming & SDKs." Dedicated — "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and enterprise SLAs." Private — "Bring inference into your VPC or on-prem for compliance and data control." Thoughts?
Anika: These read clean. For Dedicated I prefer "predictable latency" vs throughput in hero copy. E.g., "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable latency and enterprise SLAs."
Liam: For Hosted add tiny trust cue: "Start in minutes — free credits, public models & SDKs."
Maya: Ok combine: Hosted: "Start in minutes — pay-as-you-go Hosted API with streaming, SDKs, and free credits." Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity and predictable latency with SLA-backed performance." Private: "Private deployment — VPC & on-prem options for regulated workloads."
Priya: Launch-post headline options (pick 3):
- "Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference economics"
- "From prototype to production: inference that scales with your app"
- "Host it, reserve it, or keep it private — one API for every deployment"
Diego: I like #3 for broad messaging. #1 is good for developer audience (benchmarks).
Anika: For social/headline variations, shorter: "Predictable latency. Lower token costs. One API."
Maya: Nice. Now webinar benchmark narrative (60–75 words) for registration page and slide deck blurb. Keep it non-braggy but specific:
Priya: Draft: "In this webinar we compare three production LLM workloads across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. We'll show real-world benchmarks — cold-start latency, sustained throughput, and cost/sec — and walk through practical optimizations (batching, KV caching, quantization) so you can choose the right serving strategy for your product goals."
Liam: Love it. Add a line about a short live demo at the end.
Maya: Updated: "...and end with a short demo showing a latency-first vs cost-first routing policy in action."
Diego: For inbound lead routing, ops needs exact hidden field and SDR mapping. OpsBot, can you remind mapping conventions?
OpsBot: Form mapping guideline: use hidden input "product_interest" with values: hosted | dedicated | private. Routing rules send to queues: hosted-inbound, dedicated-commits, sales-enterprise-private. Include utm_source if present.
Anika: Example form snippet for Engineering to add:
```html
<input type="hidden" name="product_interest" value="private">
```
And backend pseudo-rule: `if product_interest=="private" -> queue=sales-enterprise-private`
Priya: Copy microtests — we want 3 tiny A/Bs to run for 72 hours post-launch:
1) Hosted hero CTA: "Get started" vs "Try free credits"
2) Dedicated hero subline: "predictable latency" vs "predictable throughput"
3) Webinar registration CTA: "See benchmarks" vs "Join the demo"
Maya: Perfect. Who owns experiments? Priya takes creative + analytics. Diego own tracking + GA events. Liam add the copy to Webflow and wire the hidden fields. Anika preps the draft slide with 2 benchmark charts.
Priya: Timeline: final copy by Wed EOB, Webflow changes live Thu morning, social launch Thu 11am PT, webinar Tue next week.
Diego: Tiny legal check — claim "SLA-backed" is allowed for Dedicated? OpsBot?
OpsBot: SLA clause: only reference SLA-backed for Dedicated if customer tier = Enterprise and contract includes SLA. For marketing page use "SLA-backed options" or "enterprise SLA available."
Maya: Noted — change to "SLA-backed options" in Dedicated line.
Liam: I'll push the changes and set up the two-page variants in Webflow (hero CTA A/B).
Priya: I'll prepare the short copy deck + 3 sample tweets and 3 LinkedIn posts optimized for developer vs enterprise audiences.
Anika: For the benchmark blurb on the landing page we should include a 1-line tease under the webinar CTA: "See our cold-start & sustained throughput comparisons — bring your prompts."
Maya: Final action list:
- Priya: finalize hero + launch-post headlines + social copy (due Wed EOB)
- Diego: set up GA events, UTM templates, and confirm inbound queue names (due Wed EOB)
- Liam: Webflow changes + hidden fields + A/B setup (Thu morning)
- Anika: slide draft + 2 charts (Thu morning)
- OpsBot: confirm legal phrasing for Dedicated copy (update in thread)
Maya: Thanks team — let's keep messages short in this thread for changes. :raised_hands:
Diego: ack
Priya: on it :sparkles:
Liam: starting now
Anika: on deck
OpsBot: Legal phrasing recommendation: use "SLA-backed options" for public marketing.
Maya: updating copy now and will ping when pushed to staging.
